name: Scarlet Monastery Library
summary: In Tirisfal Glades, scholars and mages seek Lordaeron's old religious and arcane records in the Scarlet Monastery Library. Crusade zealots and battle hounds patrol its halls.

sections.title: Archives of Lordaeron
sections.body:
Before the Third War, Lordaeron's priesthood came to the monastery to study. Its eastern cloisters held religious writings, histories, and arcane treatises. Then the Scarlet Crusade fortified the monastery against the Scourge. They kept the archives and armed the quiet halls.

Now beastmasters send tracking hounds through the courtyards, while battle-mages patrol the shelves. They guard the Compendium of the Fallen and ancient Titan research from outsiders.

sections.title: Guardians of the Athenaeum
sections.body:
Houndmaster Loksey guards the Huntsman's Cloister with trained hounds. They sniff out anyone seeking passage to the inner chambers. Beyond the Gallery of Treasures, Arcanist Doan watches over the Athenaeum.

A formidable mage, Doan wields devastating fire and protective sorcery. Doan studies alone and fiercely defends the Crusade's hoarded knowledge from anyone who enters the heart of the complex.

faq.q: Where is the Library within the Scarlet Monastery?
faq.answer: Enter the Grand Vestibule of the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades, then take the rightmost portal to reach the Library wing.

faq.q: Why are adventurers sent to the Library?
faq.answer: Scholars, priests, and mages from the Alliance and Horde seek precious texts kept in the Library. They seek the Compendium of the Fallen, Titan lore sought by Ironforge historians, and ancient magical manuals for rising arcanists.

aliases: who is in charge of the library
faq.answer: Arcanist Doan presides over the Library's inner sanctuary, the Athenaeum. Houndmaster Loksey and his tracking beasts guard the outer courtyard.

faq.q: What is the Scarlet Key found here?
faq.answer: A lockbox in Arcanist Doan's Athenaeum holds the Scarlet Key. It opens the heavy iron doors to the monastery's Armory and Cathedral wings.

angles.text: As a mage, you can seek ancient rituals of power in the Athenaeum. There, you can test your mettle against Arcanist Doan's destructive sorcery.
As an Alliance traveler, you can seek the Library's sacred records of Lordaeron's fallen heroes and Titan histories. Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is desperate to recover them from Crusader hands.
